title: Idempotency and retries
description: HTTP API fundamentals with standards-grounded Node.js examples, locally executable positive and negative contracts, and a complete real HTTP capstone.
objectives: Tie an idempotency key to the request fingerprint and in-flight promise; replay the same result, reject changed payloads and remove failed attempts.
Repair the http-idempotency-retry failing instructor contract.
Explain the production limitation of a local Node HTTP exercise.
rubric: I can apply the HTTP semantics for idempotency and retries.
I can reproduce and fix the 10.02.04 defect with real Node or fetch APIs.
I can explain the security or durability work needed before deployment.
